summary: Investigated a live Gizmo session error 'Context is past the auto-compaction threshold but could not be compacted: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading signal)' by tracing the error message to apps/agent-server/src/sessions/compaction-fallback.ts, then following the compaction path through session-runtime-pool.ts, the pi-coding-agent agent-session, the local patch in patches/@earendil-works__pi-coding-agent@0.84.4.patch, pi-ai's retryAssistantCall, and pi-agent-core's Agent.signal getter. The trace narrowed to unguarded `.signal` reads in pi-ai providers and the model-runtime interaction.signal path, but no fix was applied yet.
errors: Bash command 'grep -rn "could not be compacted|auto-compaction threshold" ...' timed out at 120s and was moved to background (ID b5hjbd6z2).
Bash command searching for 'retryAssistantCall' function definition exited with code 1 because no non-bundled file matched; the symbol is only present in the bundled agent-session.js.
The grep for the live server error stack 'reading signal' in .gizmo-web/server.log returned no matches, so the exact throw site for this session could not be confirmed from logs.
